description: This Java class handles delete commands for share product dividends within the Fineract project. It is an application-specific handler that invokes a service to perform the deletion based on received commands.

classes.name: DeleteShareProductDividendCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler that processes delete dividend commands for share products, utilizing the ShareProductWritePlatformService to perform the deletion.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to delete a share product dividend, calling the corresponding service method.
